name: leandojo_benchmark_lean4_17_0
description: A benchmark of Lean 4 libraries and proof tasks designed to evaluate models' ability to generate or complete formal proofs and Lean code. It measures whether generated proof scripts or tactics are syntactically correct and verify successfully in the Lean 4 environment. The benchmark focuses on formal reasoning, tactic usage, and precise code generation rather than natural-language outputs.
reputation: A niche dataset hosted on Hugging Face for the Lean/formal-methods community and code-model evaluations with limited mainstream adoption.
